resources.string: Studio-only backup of the UNA database, installed modules, and storage files.

For complete server-loss recovery: install the matching UNA core, install My UNA World, copy your backup ZIPs into the private backup folder, then use Recovery to register, inspect, dry-run, and restore.
Manage verified backup archives and run inspect, dry-run, restore, download, or delete operations.
Re-register downloaded backups after a fresh UNA installation, upload smaller backup files, and manage restore/rollback reports.

For large backups, copy the original ZIP and optional sidecars into this private folder using SFTP, SCP, or your hosting file manager. My UNA World can then validate and register them without a web upload.
No My UNA World ZIP archives were found in the private backup folder.
Use this for smaller backups that fit your PHP/web-server upload limits. Large backups should be copied directly to the private backup folder and registered above.
No restore or rollback reports are present.
Restricts logged-out visitors to Home, Login, Create Account, Forgot Password, Terms, and Privacy. Logged-in members and administrators remain unrestricted.
Create a full safety snapshot before a newly installed UNA module changes the site.
Backup before module removal or update
Create a full safety snapshot before an installed module is removed or updated.
Block the module operation if its safety backup fails
Recommended. UNA will not proceed with the module change if My UNA World cannot create its pre-change safety backup.
Automatically limit private backup storage by archive count and/or age. A backup is deleted when it exceeds either enabled limit. Protected rollback safety backups are never automatically deleted.
Enter 0 for unlimited. Example: 10 keeps the 10 newest eligible backup archives.
Enter 0 to disable age-based deletion. Example: 30 removes eligible backups older than 30 days.
Manual backups run through UNA's background worker. Return to Overview or Backups at any time to see current progress.
